selection.split: sha256(dialogue-index) modulo 3: zero development, otherwise evaluation
selection.qrels: Upstream structured relation plus literal answer span; strict supporting-evidence precision, not general topical relevance.

fixed.candidate_scope: Companion cue/document seeding only; canonical graph priors, coalescence and Witness remain precise jieba except the canonical unicode baseline.
fixed.warm_history: Recall the first two eligible observed utterances, without consulting qrels.

selection_gate.development: Choose highest cold positive recall@6 satisfying all guards against precise; ties use MRR then declared candidate order. No fitting on evaluation.
selection_gate.production_adoption: Ineligible from this single-domain, relation-filtered pilot alone; a passing candidate advances to independent multi-domain judgments and graph-policy evaluation. No automatic default change.

limitations: Both study splits originate in upstream film/dev; they are dialogue-disjoint local splits, not the official KdConv test set.
Relations and literal answer spans define mechanical evidence labels; no independent human relevance judgments are claimed.
Dialogue entities may overlap across splits and are reported.
Replay sessions and timestamps are artificial; no long-horizon retention or human attachment claim.
No model-generated answers, semantic embeddings or attachment-weight tuning.
